name: Angel
source: An angel residing in the depths of the dungeon. With her beautiful, pure form and recovery magic, she's the epitome of an angel. She appears to be some kind of divine messenger, but the identity of the god she serves is unclear.She corrupts adventurers who come to visit her under the guise of healing them.
